title: Surreal Chicken Tree
description: A surreal tree with a large bird-like head featuring an orange beak and a single purple eye grows from a metal bucket. It sits atop a wooden staircase adorned with pink roses, grapes, and scattered white feathers. White and purple doves fly around the leafy canopy against a starry cosmic background with colorful nebulae and shooting stars. A blue sign reading 'CHICKEN SHIT' is posted on the stairs.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a gnarled tree growing from an old metal bucket, the tree trunk forming a large bird head with a long orange beak and one oversized purple eye with long lashes. The canopy consists of green and blue leaves mixed with white and purple doves in flight. The bucket rests on a wooden staircase covered in pink roses, grapes, and white feathers. A dripping blue sign says CHICKEN SHIT. Background is black space with vibrant purple and blue nebulae, constellations, and glowing shooting stars.
